name: Differentiable Regularization Framework for Participating Media
definition: A framework for rendering high-albedo participating media with low time budgets, combining differentiable path tracing, temporal gradient denoising, and a novel prediction function to reduce noise compared to volumetric path tracing.
summary: This method reduces noise in high-albedo participating media by extrapolating from a low-albedo render using albedo gradients, outperforming standard path tracing under time constraints.
